summary: This invoice covers the completion of Phase 1 (Landing page, menu, and branding) and Phase 2 (Online booking system with email notifications) for Kopi Labs. It includes responsive web design, interactive menu integration, complete booking workflow, and performance optimizations.

line_items.name: Landing Page, Branding, and Header Setup

line_items.name: Interactive Menu Section

line_items.name: Online Booking System
line_items.description: Developed the interactive booking form featuring date pickers, form validation, custom styling, and API submission.

line_items.name: Email Notification Integration & Booking QA
line_items.description: Connected the booking form to automated email notifications and performed final booking workflow refinements.

line_items.name: Mobile Optimization, SEO & Copy Updates
